items.text: Masoud Pezeshkian spoke about the killing of students in the war. Morteza Kazemian criticized these remarks and referred to the December killings during Pezeshkian's government. He questioned the ethical legitimacy of such statements.

Alireza Beiranvand must be conscripted for military service on the first of Aban. His medical requests, including shoulder injury and referral to the neurology and psychiatry commission, were reviewed but not approved. The location and manner of his service are not yet determined and will be announced in the coming days.

Yesterday, a minibus carrying seasonal workers collided with a car on the Piranshahr to Mirabad route. This accident resulted in injuries to five workers. More details are published by Harana News Agency.

The Houthis launched a deadly attack on Riyadh International Airport. This issue and escalating tensions in the Middle East are the focus of the EU foreign ministers' meeting in Luxembourg. Iran's developments and maritime security are also discussed in the meeting.
A citizen sent a video showing a protest poster next to an ATM in Zanjan. The poster protests the rise in currency prices. He says our money has no value anymore.

Majid Ibn al-Reza, acting Minister of Defense, warned about the dangers of civilizational confrontation and playing with fire. He emphasized that Iran's armed forces are ready to respond and that the US should not play with fire. Ibn al-Reza stated that a civilizational assault cannot force the Iranian nation to retreat.

The judiciary of the Islamic Republic announced the execution of Omar Dorostaran, a member of the Jaish al-Adl group. He was accused of supporting attacks on military bases in Rask and Chabahar counties in Farvardin 1403. The judiciary did not provide any explanation about the trial proceedings.

Messages received by Iran International indicate worsening living conditions for workers and drivers in various cities. Some have not been paid for several months and their insurance has been cut off. The living crisis has intensified alongside rising currency and essential goods prices.

A 33-year-old young man reports severe economic problems and currency devaluation in Iran. He complains about increased theft and insecurity, high inflation, and the social security's failure to pay unemployment insurance. He also points to rising prices of daily goods and declining purchasing power.

Retired telecommunications workers in Khuzestan held a protest march in Ahvaz today. They demanded the implementation of regulation 89/24 and attention to their demands. The protesters objected to the supplementary insurance situation and the arbitrary increase in insurance premiums.
